gloss: castle tower; keep; main tower of a Japanese castle

definitions.gloss: castle tower; keep; main tower of a Japanese castle
definitions.explanation: The central, tallest tower of a Japanese castle, serving as both a symbol of the lord's power and a final defensive stronghold. A defining feature of Japanese castle architecture.

examples.japanese: {天守閣|てんしゅかく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろした→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧。
examples.english: I looked down at the town from the castle tower.

examples.japanese: {姫路城|ひめじじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天守閣|てんしゅかく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The keep of Himeji Castle is designated as a national treasure.

examples.english: There are many castles whose towers were destroyed in war and rebuilt in concrete.

notes:
USAGE:
Of Japan's many castles, only twelve retain their original wooden {天守閣|てんしゅかく}, known as {現存天守|げんぞんてんしゅ}. The most famous include {姫路城|ひめじじょう}, {松本城|まつもとじょう}, and {犬山城|いぬやまじょう}. Many others have been rebuilt in modern materials.

The shorter form ⟦{天守|てんしゅ}→天守：24238_tenshu⟧ is used interchangeably in many contexts, though {天守閣|てんしゅかく} is more common in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天守閣|てんしゅかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧ (to climb the castle tower)
- {天守閣|てんしゅかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再建|さいけん}→再建：11743_saiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rebuild the castle tower)
- {現存|げんぞん}⟦{天守|てんしゅ}→天守：24238_tenshu⟧ (original surviving keep)
- {天守閣|てんしゅかく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧ (view from the castle tower)
